findings.summary: The smoke script's step ② success path is now permanently unreachable against the real bus. IDEMPOTENCY_KEY reuses the constant already consumed by this development's attempt 1, whose run created entity msg_01KZ6FT90ZH11S18KH3FQZ4CE3 and revised it to in_flight; agent-bus is append-only, so ① will dedupe and ② will return conflict forever. The pasted run in IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md confirms this (② error=conflict, no message_id/channel_seq for steps ②③, so spec §5.2's "三步的 message_id 与 channel_seq" is only partially evidenced). This is acceptable here — the deduplicated branch is exactly the gate state spec §5.2 predicts, the strict expect(claimed.success).toBe(true) is preserved for the fresh case, and the real CAS revision write was exercised against the bus by attempt 1 with a byte-identical src/bus.ts (the prior final review's citations to src/bus.ts:234-237 and :70-74 still land on those exact constructs). But choosing a new fixed constant key for this attempt would have satisfied §5.2 literally while keeping the write cap and gate dedup; as delivered, a future regression in casUpdateClue's real-bus revision publish would not be caught by this smoke.
